mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia; calcium supplementation may mask or worsen electrolyte abnormalities and increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias due to altered electrolyte balance.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, magnesium, calcium) regularly during amphotericin B therapy; avoid empiric calcium supplementation without documented hypocalcemia; correct hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia before or concurrent with any calcium administration.
